protocol: StratifiedGroupKFold(5) x 10 repeats, grouped by KIC star id
missingness_augmentation: stellar group and photometry group masked in training copies, identical across classes
data_source: Kepler long-cadence light curves (MAST) + NASA Exoplanet Archive cumulative KOI table dispositions/false-positive flags; 2MASS + Pan-STARRS DR1 colours via CDS X-Match.
known_gaps: Trained on Kepler, served on TESS: SNR-type features scale with the number of observed transits, so outputs are not calibrated the same way on a single 27-day TESS sector. See tess_transfer_check.
No centroid information: Kepler's 'Eclipsing Binary' label includes its centroid-offset flag, which this model cannot see. Real TESS centroid offsets are reported separately (has_centroid_dip).
Small sample: the CV spread above is the honest uncertainty on the headline accuracy.
